value.rationale: This is a complete exact structural invariant (37 nonempty palindrome factors, length cutoff 23) for a natural published nonuniform Parikh-collinear fixed point with known aperiodic abelian-complexity behavior. Stronger all-position factor saturation gives exact defect N-37 for every long factor, not merely a finite prefix census. The finiteness result also supplies the previously unestablished premise needed for the known regular prefix-palindromic-length theorem. The problem is motivated by comparing abelian and reversal complexity in this established example; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine restatement.
